name: 77489 · Missouri City, TX
findings: ZIP 77489 (Missouri City) has 144 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77489 (Missouri City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 25 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
